message:
Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/ssml-fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 48, "var": "data", "code": "char *str = malloc(size+1); memcpy(str, data, size); str[size] = 0;", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes are copied into a heap buffer and null-terminated."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/ssml-fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 50, "var": "str", "code": "espeak_Synth((char*) str, size + 1, 0, POS_CHARACTER, 0, synth_flags, NULL, NULL);", "note": "The input string is passed to espeak_Synth with espeakSSML flag, triggering SSML parsing."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c", "function": "ReadClause", "line": 602, "var": "xml_buf", "code": "terminator = ProcessSsmlTag(xml_buf, buf, &ix, n_buf, ...);", "note": "The '<break strength=\"invalid\"/>' tag is extracted into xml_buf and passed to ProcessSsmlTag."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c", "function": "ProcessSsmlTag", "line": 850, "var": "attr1", "code": "attr1 = GetSsmlAttribute(px, \"strength\");", "note": "The strength attribute value \"invalid\" is retrieved from the tag."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c", "function": "ProcessSsmlTag", "line": 852, "var": "value", "code": "value = attrlookup(attr1, mnem_break);", "note": "attrlookup fails to find \"invalid\" in mnem_break table and returns -1 (the NULL entry's value)."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c", "function": "ProcessSsmlTag", "line": 856, "var": "break_value[value]", "code": "value = break_value[value];", "note": "break_value[-1] reads 4 bytes before the start of the static break_value array, causing an out-of-bounds read (heap-buffer-overflow READ)."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace created" && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON')"
